name: Crantock Plains Touring Park
suitableFor: Campers and walkers wanting peace and space
beachAccess: About 2 km from Crantock village; Newquay about 5 km
overview: A family-run touring park in the countryside just off the A3075, about two kilometres from Crantock village and five kilometres from Newquay. It is aimed at campers who want peace, quiet and space rather than entertainment.
surfTripFit: A peaceful, low-key camping base a short drive from Crantock, Holywell and the Newquay beaches.
